item.description:
Sanitation | Procurement | Award | $900K | Vendor: Lenox Hill Radiology & Medical Imaging Associates

The NYC Department of Sanitation (DSNY) Health Care Facility is an occupational health facility with a medical staff that evaluates the medical condition(s) of its uniform and non-uniform employees. Evaluations include fitness for duty, safety, return-to-work, and pre-employment evaluations. DSNY is looking to hire a Contractor that can provide X-rays with Interpretations for DSNYs pre-employment screening program. This screening process is essential for candidates applying for the Sanitation Worker position, as it involves a thorough medical evaluation. During this evaluation, candidates are interviewed, and objective medical evidence, including X-rays, is required. The purpose of obtaining these X-rays is to assist the Medical Director and/or the designated medical team in determining whether the candidate meets the necessary qualifications to work for DSNY.

item.title: Clarke Bronx Family Criminal Courthouse Roof Upgrade
item.description:
Design and Construction | Procurement | Award | $18.9M | Vendor: Corbex Inc.

This project consists of full replacement of the existing roofing systems at all roof levels to provide a system with an associated long-term warranty and complying with current energy efficiency standards. A total of 45,300SF roof area, in 26 separate roofs at nine different floor levels will receive a new roofing system of two types: cold-applied liquid roofing and paver-protected cold-applied liquid roofing. The concrete deck cracks, delamination, and any other form of deterioration will be repaired from the exterior and interior sides. A new roof rail guard will be installed, and all existing roof guard rails will be reinforced. All existing roof drains will be retrofitted with new retrofit roof drains. The limited mechanical work scope includes replacing two existing RTUs with two new similar units. Electrical scope includes reconnection of the two new RT units and replacement of exterior light fixtures at the Cooling Tower Courtyard. CB: Bronx 4

item.title: Plastic Modular Bus Boarder Components
item.description:
Transportation | Procurement | Award | $450K | Vendor: ZICLACITIES SL

To maintain the upkeep of the Vectorial Bus Boarder System, the agency will enter into an agreement with El Almacen Del Producto Reciclado (ZICLA) to purchase Plastic Modular Bus Boarder components to replace those diminished and degraded through usage. Bus Boarders (also known as bus bulbs) are platforms that augment the speed and reliability benefits which dedicated bus lanes deliver, allowing buses operating in offset bus lane configurations (i.e., one lane out from the curbside parking/loading lane) to load and unload passenger without having to pull over to the curb and then pull back out. Boarders are also effective in keeping vehicles from blocking bus stops. Bus Boarders are also deployed on routes where two-way bike paths run along the same curb where bus stops exist. Boarding platforms eliminate bus-bike head-on conflict at stops, in which buses encroach the travel path of cyclists, causing bikes to merge into contraflow traffic to pass stopped buses. The bike paths ramp up to platform height where it becomes a shared space, and then ramp down after the bus stop.

Programs are offered at no cost to youth and are purposefully located in public and private schools, community centers, religious institutions, public housing and parks recreational facilities throughout the City to help families find a place that best fits their youth's needs.
